learning_outcomes.text: Students have very good competencies for independent design, implementation, and testing of Java programs.
Students understand the concepts of modular software design.

Through programming exercises in lectures, students are able to understand and criticize the content of their colleagues' programs and complement them with their own programs. They are able to create programs in a form that allows team cooperation.
Students have the ability to create programs using a modern object-oriented programming platform.
Students can implement their own software engineering ideas and defend them against competing approaches.

syllabus_topics: Deepening OOP and modeling with UML
Review of data types, syntax, conventions
Primitive data types and reference data types
Helper classes: Math, Random, Arrays, Objects, Collections, System
Inheritance, Abstract Classes, Interfaces and Generics
Inner Classes, Local Classes, Anonymous Classes
Java Code Conventions, Design Patterns and Clean Code
jLink (Native Version with JLink, since Java 11)
assessment_rules: The module examination is a written test of 90 minutes. The weighting of the grade is 5/210.
